name: whatsapp-bot
description: Sierra Estates WhatsApp bot — Liela/Sierra/OpenClaw/Hermes routing pipeline. Standalone agent (NOT in the pnpm workspace graph): install with `npm install` in this directory and run from a full repo checkout so the @sierra-estates/* imports resolve via the root tsconfig paths.
_comment_overrides: Security overrides for transitive deps. This package is NOT in the pnpm workspace, so the root pnpm overrides do not reach it and Dependabot must patch it independently — it kept failing to, because js-yaml resolves at two different majors here (3.x under @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config via jest, 4.x under cosmiconfig via whatsapp-web.js) and Dependabot conflated them, capping its own bump at 4.3.0. The nested override below pins each major to its own patched release. Regenerate with: npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
